institution_waivers.note: Direct Entry: accepts a) NCE merit in relevant subjects as well as UTME requirements; b) Two (2) GCE 'A' level passes or its equivalent and three (3) other 'O' Level credit passes.
UTME: accepts 'O' Level credit passes in Literature in English and other Arts and Social Science subjects.
UTME: requires Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any three Arts or Social Sciences. Civic Education and Computer Studies are also accepted.
UTME: 'O' Level credit pass in German is not compulsory.
UTME: requires 'O' Level credit passes in English Language and four (4) other subjects. History or Literature in English will be an advantage.
UTME Subjects: requires Literature in English plus one Arts subject and any other Arts or Social Science subject.
UTME Subjects: requires English Language and any three Arts or Social Sciences.
UTME Subjects: requires any three (3) subjects.
